subject: general
question:
There are four underlined words in the sentence given below. One of them is misspelt. Choose the option with the misspelt word.

The central bank __stressed__ the importance of __prudance__ in __fiscal__ policy to maintain stability and avoid unnecessary pressure on the national __currency__.
solution:
The correct answer is **option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The misspelled word in the given sentence is **'prudance'**.
 
• The correct spelling is **'prudence'**.
 
• 'Prudence' is a **noun** that means cautiousness or the quality of being prudent, especially in financial matters. **(सावधानी)**

**Correct sentence:** The central bank stressed the importance of prudence in fiscal policy to maintain stability and avoid unnecessary pressure on the national currency.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Let’s understand the meanings of the other marked words:**

 
• **Stressed:** Emphasized the importance of something **(जोर दिया)**.
 
• **Fiscal:** Relating to government revenue, especially taxes **(राजकोषीय)**.
 
• **Currency:** A system of money in general use in a particular country **(मुद्रा)**.
